title: The Five-Step Process, Step 2: Facing Problems Boldly and Intolerantly
summary: Following a successful Mission Leadership Council held via Zoom, President Hughes presents Step 2 of his five-step process: identifying and refusing to tolerate problems. He breaks down six basic sub-steps for managing obstacles, urging missionaries to look past the shame of their personal weaknesses, accurately distinguish problems from their root causes, and embrace hard choices to ensure an easier life mortally and eternally.
